title: Activating the oxide pathway mechanism via selective intralayer Cl coordination with Ni/Fe sites of hydroxides for robust water oxidation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE07316B, Paper
Guanwen Wang, Chunlei Chi, Yufei Zhou, Baoyi Mu, Qiushi Miao, Bin Qi, Xinhou Yang, Fan Feng, Liang Wu, Xinxin Zhao, Yichao Huang, Chuanqing Wang, Tong Wei, Zhuangjun Fan
Selective intralayer Cl coordination (21.6 wt%) of NiFe(OH)xCly optimizes the electronic configuration, induces specific substitution of OH− and triggers O–O coupling of OPM, delivering 217 mV@0.1 A cm−2 and 3000 h@1 A cm−2.
